user.title: Connect to openCook
user.description: Enter the server URL and your household invite code from openCook. The invite code is the shared sync credential, not the household join PIN or admin password. Your household must already exist on this server.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect openCook
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or household invite code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect openCook
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the saved household invite code. Enter the current URL and code.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to a compatible openCook server. Check the URL, server logs and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: The household invite code was rejected. Use the invite code, not the join PIN or admin password.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full http:// or https:// URL, without embedded credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
